h1: Watersound Crossings "Above It All Penthouse" 337 South Bridge Lane Unit 422B
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Gulf views- 3 adult bikes provided- Fantastic porch spaces- Pool and Beach are just yards away- Free WiFi- Dedicated work space for a mini office- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private deeded beach access- Fitness center- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*The property does not come with dedicated parking spaces, however 2 vehicles can enter the community for the opportunity to park in the first come first serve parking. Please note first come first serve parking is limited and not guaranteed.DETAILS: Unfettered Gulf views and resort-style luxury await at Above It All Penthouse, a 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom WaterSound Crossings penthouse that sleeps 8 guests. With a sparkling community pool, BBQ area, gym, and dedicated beach access, guests of this gated community enjoy a carefree escape designed for making memories. Imagine days brimming with magnificent panoramic Gulf views from the balcony, refreshing swims, sandy toes, and quick strolls to the sugar-soft sands—the boardwalk is only yards away!A picture-perfect coastal setting awaits inside this single-story, top-floor condo. As guests step past the entryway into the opulent great room, 12-foot ceilings and an elegant expanse of curved windows offer a striking architectural focal point, framing breathtaking, unobstructed Gulf views and setting the space aglow with natural light. The state-of-the-art kitchen’s sleek marble countertops and Viking appliances beckon guests to discover their inner chef—while enjoying the view. Jura and Keurig coffee machines, along with a butler’s pantry with a bar and wine cooler, make crafting refreshments a breeze.The luxuriant living area hosts an array of comfy seating, an electric fireplace, and a TV for laid-back evenings of entertainment. Opposite sits the 6-person dining table, where guests can savor seafood feasts beside the beach view. Neutral tones, golden wood floors, and creatively crafted original art add to the serene environment. On the expansive deck, sip coffee or watch the sunset from the teak rocking chairs while savoring the coastal atmosphere and pristine natural beauty of the undisturbed dunes and 2-mile private beach stretching out to the clear turquoise water. Retire for a peaceful night in the primary bedroom, featuring incredible views, a king bed, and a spa-like private bathroom. The first guest bedroom has a king bed with 2 trundle beds, and the other has a queen bed—both feature private bathrooms. A laundry room adds convenience for extended stays.Experience an enchanting 30A getaway at WaterSound Crossing’s Above It All Penthouse. Free parking for up to 2 vehicles, plus 3 complimentary adult bikes, makes it easy to explore the nearby neighborhoods and attractions, including Seacrest Beach and The Big Chill. For beach access, follow the boardwalk at the back of the building. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 8):- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed and 2 Trundle Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyAMENITIES INCLUDE: 3 adult bikes provided, Gulf front. Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforters laundered upon every checkout. 360 BLUE STAFF & SERVICES: Exclusive Guest Experiences, Concierge Services, Grocery Delivery, Private Chef & More (Extra costs & advanced notice may be required)*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blu
